summary: Clearway kerb on busy Moggill Road, no parking lane or pull-off.
reasons: Clearway sign, no room to stop
Shopfronts and traffic lights beside kerb

drivers.seclusion: Shops 13-15 m away, houses 22 m or more; fully exposed.

drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with buses and queuing traffic.
drivers.convention: Clearway C Mon-Sat 4-7 pm; no cars parked along this kerb.

sun_shade: Open to sun; shop buildings to the south.
